scores.evidence: Tables s2-table and s5-table, the code blocks and the quizzes are clean at 390 px and 1440 px (mobile-jp-07/08/13/14, desktop-jp-05/09). The one defect is the s2-layers diagram: on mobile its right branch node is cut off at the edge (mobile-jp-07). On desktop it fits (desktop-jp-04/05).

No screen is plain text only (textOnlyScreens is empty for both devices), and every section breaks up its text with definitions, lists, tables, code or a check. The practice section runs about 5 mobile screens (mobile-jp-15 to 20). It is chunked, but it shows three separate one-step 'steps' blocks, each one headed '手順 1ステップ中 0 完了' and numbered 1.

The lesson is in Japanese only and no English UI strings leak into it. Contrast is good, the diagram has alt text and a caption, and inline code in the quiz options stays readable. There are a few awkward mobile line breaks: an orphaned 'ない' in s1-practices item 2 (mobile-jp-04) and 'claude -' / 'p' split across lines in e5 (mobile-jp-24, known reader wrapping).
